title: A needed resource in the sexuality debate
excerpt: As I said in my most recent book (the Sex Question), I think there are many issues being addressed at the same time in the debate about human sexuality. Here’s a new resource that I had the honor of contributing to … I think it will be helpful on many of those levels.
